summary: The contract has only 23 possible scheduled hours and 24 possible delays, and one addition plus one modulo operation handles every pair.

workload_bound.source_constraint: arrivalTime ranges from 1 through 23 and delayedTime ranges from 1 through 24

replacement_checks.evidence: Every legal input is processed by exactly one integer addition and one remainder operation, independent of the hour values.
Regression checks all 23 times 24 legal input pairs against repeated 24-hour normalization.
